verdict.rationale: Proton Pass documents built-in TOTP generation for saved logins and passkey support. Community users praise the browser extension and say they use Pass for all their 2FA, but no evidence explicitly says the extension autofills TOTP codes or passkeys at login. missing for 10: first-party docs confirming the extension autofills TOTP codes into login forms, evidence that the extension handles passkey sign-in, hands-on corroboration of the autofill flow.
